events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey T-155 files, commit, ledger and related task states
events.input: $ wc -l workshop-plan/scripts/fintechcircle-experiment.mjs workshop-plan/dogfooding/*.md workshop-plan/probe-feedback.mjs cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md 2>&1; git show --stat --oneline 5349521 | head; git status --short workshop-plan/scripts workshop-plan/dogfooding workshop-plan/probe-feedback.mjs scripts/walkthroughs | head; grep -n -i "fintechcircle\|T-155" scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md | cut -c1-400; grep -n -i "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3; ls ~/.config/tantra 2>&1 | head -5; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read specs, backlog, probe, ledger row and simulator startup
events.input: $ cat workshop-plan/dogfooding/FINTECHCIRCLE_EXPERIMENT.md | cut -c1-900; echo ----; cut -c1-260 workshop-plan/dogfooding/GROWTH_BACKLOG.md; echo ----; cat workshop-plan/probe-feedback.mjs | cut -c1-300; echo ---; sed -n 32p scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md; grep -n "argparse\|add_argument\|SIM_STATE\|environ" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -20; sed -n 1,30p cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | cut -c1-200
